content: Culi Kǝra Yesu Biya Sara Gwa
Lǝkakaɗǝ tsǝtsǝfǝ ar kǝra Yesu Kǝrsiti zǝr Dawuda, kǝra tsu zǝr Ibrahimu ngau.
Ibrahimu ngǝ yabiya Ishaku, kǝ Ishaku yabiya Yakubu, kǝ Yakubu yabiya Yahuda ǝnga zamǝ nyiˈyar.
Yahuda tsu ngǝ yabiya Parisu ǝnga Zara, kǝra mǝr nda ngǝ Tamaru. Parisu ngǝ yabiya Hesaruna, kǝ Hesaruna yabiya Aramu,
kǝ Aramu yabiya Aminadaɓǝu, kǝ Aminadaɓǝu yabiya Nashanu, kǝ Nashanu yabiya Salmonu.
Salmonu ngǝ yabiya Buˈaza, kǝra mǝnyi ngǝ Rahapǝu. Buˈaza ngǝ yabiya Obida, kǝra mǝnyi ngǝ Ruthlu. Obida ngǝ yabiya Jesi,
ǝnga Jesi ngǝ yabiya tǝl Dawuda. Dawuda ngǝ yabiya Solomanu, kǝra mǝnyi ɗǝɗǝmǝ mala Yuraya ngau.
Solomanu ngǝ yabiya Rahubwamu, kǝ Rahubwamu yabiya Abijanu, kǝ Abijanu yabiya Asa,
kǝ Asa yabiya Jahwashafatu, kǝ Jahwashafatu yabiya Jahwaramu, kǝ Jahwaramu yabiya Uziya.
Uziya ngǝ yabiya Jothlamu, kǝ Jothlamu yabiya Ahazu, kǝ Ahazu yabiya Hezikaya,
kǝ Hezikaya yabiya Manasa, kǝ Manasa yabiya Amonu, kǝ Amonu yabiya Josaya,
ǝnga Josaya ngǝ yabiya Jakoniya ǝnga zamǝ nyiˈyar. Ar pǝci kǝra nji faˈar nda a vu mafakur a vu ˈyiˈyir Babilanu.
Ayukuɗa nji faˈar nda a vu Babilanu, kǝ Jakoniya yabiya Shaltiyalu, kǝ Shaltiyalu yabiya Zarubabelu,
kǝ Zarubabelu yabiya Abiyadu, kǝ Abiyadu yabiya Eliyakimu, kǝ Eliyakimu yabiya Azoru.
Azoru ngǝ yabiya Zadoku, kǝ Zadoku yabiya Akimu, kǝ Akimu yabiya Eludu,
kǝ Eludu yabiya Eliyaza, kǝ Eliyaza yabiya Matanu, kǝ Matanu yabiya Yakubu,
ǝnga Yakubu ngǝ yabiya Yusufu, saliya Maryamu, mala kǝra yabiya Yesu, ndǝra nju ngga ǝnga Kǝrsiti.

Abangǝ ngǝ patǝkura zamana nyiˈyar, dzǝgwar Ibrahimu baˈanǝ Dawuda zaman kumo apǝ foɗǝu, dzǝgwar Dawuda baˈanǝ mafakur wu ˈyiˈyir Babilanu zaman kumo apǝ foɗǝu, dzǝgwar mafakur wu ˈyiˈyir Babilanu baˈanǝ shilǝr Kǝrsiti zaman kumo apǝ foɗǝu.
Yar Yesu Kǝrsiti
Kǝja ǝnggǝra nji ya Yesu Kǝrsiti. Mǝnyi kǝra nju ngga ǝnga Maryamu a mbiyari alkawal nǝ hǝdzǝ ǝnga Yusufu. Ama kadivira nda hǝrdzau, ba nji thlǝwa nyi ǝnga huɗǝ sara ara Mambǝl Cicau.
Ara sal mǝmba nyi Yusufu ndǝ tsapǝ ngau ǝnga ǝtsu naju yiwu ja hǝna sǝli nyi wu pama nji mai, kǝ ji gwu ɗǝnga lagu kǝra ja sǝn sǝya nyi ɗǝɗǝwa.

Ama tsu ju ɗǝnga sǝ kau, kǝ waladi Thlagǝ cabiya nyi kǝr wu shuni. Ji na anǝ nyi, “Yusufu zǝr Dawuda, a sara ga hivǝr hǝ Maryamu aga ja ɗa mala ngǝ mai, ara huɗǝ kǝra ara ja sara ara Mambǝl Cici nga nyi.
Ju nda yabiya zǝr sal, ba ga fiya nyi thlǝmǝ Yesu, arya ju nda mbǝɗana nji gǝ nda sara ara bikǝr nda.”
Patǝkura sǝˈyar kǝ ɗarkǝr aga ja nyabiya sǝra Thlagǝ nana lagu miya nabi abǝr,
“Kwapǝliyagǝ kǝra gǝra sǝn ndǝ sal, wu nda hǝr huɗǝu, ju nda yabiya zǝsal, nju nda fiya nyi thlǝmǝ Emanuwelu,” kǝra ca ngǝ, “Hyal ǝnga mǝn.”
Ənggǝra Yusufu hyaˈari sara wu ghanyi, kǝ ji mǝliya sǝra waladi Thlagǝ nar nyi ja mǝl, ca ngǝ, ba ji hǝri Maryamu aga mala nyi.
Ama nandǝ nggya ndǝ sal ǝnga mala mai, kǝl ayukuɗa ji yabiya zǝr nyi. Ba Yusufu fiya nyi thlǝmǝ Yesu.
